Continuous hip–thigh–knee–ankle construction, grey paws. This is a genuinely careful walk, not standing or tripping. Each character keeps its own canonical anatomy: preserve skull/muzzle, eye size/spacing, ears/neck, lean torso, orange tail and cream patch, limb/paw widths and intrinsic felt colors. Use the attached canonical and that character’s own visible measurement guide; never apply Milo ratios to Leo or draw annotation marks. Full character and tail with generous margins, closed toothless mouth, natural soft neutral illumination, genuine transparent alpha. No scene, ground plane, cast shadow, text, icons or watermark. One output only. New pose, net design/contact and numerical anatomy remain subject to owner review.
